newsitem.title: INDIA: India Hindalco down 3 pct before results.
newsitem.headline: India Hindalco down 3 pct before results.

text.p: Shares of Indian aluminium major Hindalco Industries dropped 24.50 rupees, or 2.6 percent, to 908.0 at the Bombay exchange on Monday ahead of the company's meeting to announce its results, traders said.
The board of Hindalco Industries will meet later on Monday to announce results for the year ending March 31, 1997.
Nearly 6,000 shares were traded in early afternoon deals.
Hindalco's net profit is seen 2.8 percent, higher at 4.12 billion rupees against the corresponding period last year, a recent Reuters poll found.
The company's sales are expected to drop 3.8 percent, to 12.04 billion rupees from 12.52 billion.
At the National Stock Exchange, the stock lost 26.15 rupees, or 2.80 percent, to 908.75 rupees in volumes of 4,750 shares.
